definitions.gloss: to advance by winning; to win through (to the next round)
definitions.explanation: To keep winning in a tournament or elimination contest and move up to the next stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: They won their way to the final.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一回戦|いっかいせん}→一回戦：08960_ikkaisen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: To advance smoothly from the first round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無名|むめい}→無名：13420_mumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{地方大会|ちほうたいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がり、⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}→出場：03223_shutsujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: An unknown high school won through the regional tournament and earned a place at Koshien.

notes:
⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (to win) + ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to go up). Used for tournaments, elimination rounds, and playoffs; the destination is marked with ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がる: to win through to the final
- {勝|か}ち{上|あ}がった⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧: the team that advanced
- ⟦{予選|よせん}→予選：04745_yosen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がる: to win through the qualifying rounds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勝|か}ち{進|すす}む: to advance by winning — nearly the same; {勝|か}ち{上|あ}がる stresses climbing to a higher stage
- ⟦{敗退|はいたい}→敗退：06840_haitai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be eliminated — the opposite outcome
